# Art Form Plastic Surgery

> Art Form Plastic Surgery is a board-certified facial plastic surgery practice serving Safety Harbor, Tampa, and nearby Tampa Bay communities. The practice is led by Dr. Christopher Kieliszak and focuses on facial balance, natural-looking results, patient education, and consultation-based treatment planning.

### Hair restoration
URL: https://artformplasticsurgery.com/hair-restoration/
Summary: Hair restoration consultations in Tampa Bay for thinning hair, PRP hair restoration, FUE/FUT hair transplant planning, PDO threads for hair loss, and natural hairline goals.
  - What is the difference between PRP and a hair transplant? PRP is a non-surgical injection series intended to support follicle health, while a hair transplant relocates follicles from a donor area to thinning areas. Some patients benefit from both approaches.
  - Who is a good candidate for hair restoration? Good candidates for hair restoration are patients with clear goals, realistic expectations, and anatomy or concerns that match the treatment. A consultation reviews health history, timing, facial balance, and whether a surgical or non-surgical option is the better fit.

  - What is the difference between a facelift and mini facelift? A mini facelift usually targets earlier lower-face laxity with a shorter recovery, while a more comprehensive facelift may address deeper jowling, jawline and neck changes.
  - How long should I plan for facelift recovery? Recovery varies, but many patients plan for two or more weeks before social activities, with swelling and refinement improving over time.

Summary: Otoplasty and ear pinning consultations in Tampa Bay for prominent ears, ear asymmetry, recovery, cost, and natural-looking facial harmony.
  - What age is appropriate for otoplasty? Many patients are evaluated in childhood or adulthood depending on ear development, goals and timing. Consultation helps determine whether now is the right time.
  - How long is otoplasty recovery? Most patients plan for swelling, a protective headband period and activity limits during early healing. Return-to-work timing is reviewed during consultation.
  - Who is a good candidate for otoplasty? Good candidates for otoplasty are patients with clear goals, realistic expectations, and anatomy or concerns that match the treatment. A consultation reviews health history, timing, facial balance, and whether a surgical or non-surgical option is the better fit.
